items.title: Joseph 'One Eyed Babe' Phillips Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: Well, they had a, they was mixed up. Settle and Youngster, they was mixed up. They had a seven-piece orchestra too.

ctx.x: Who was in that band, the Pickwick band?
Well, they had a, they was mixed up. Settle and Youngster, they was mixed up. They had a seven-piece orchestra too. But they had a brass band.
That was a brass band? The Pickwick band?
